# Changelog - v5.2.2

## [v5.2.2-2]
### Fixes & Improvements
- Added missing include.
- Added debug output.
- Fixed NAT64 prefix byte order.
- Added UBUS support for buildroot.

## [v5.2.2-1]
### Fixes & Improvements
- Added NAT64 ndAddr helpers.
- Added support for valgrind DRD.
- Added SSL CA cert dependency.
- Fixed issue with `addr16[]` not being supported in FreeBSD.
- Added `.gitignore`.
- Removed plugins from default `Config.in`.
